# Mind Grace Neuropsychiatric Clinic

> Adult neuropsychiatric care and academic training at Mind Grace, with all child-related care through Aasha Child Development & Early Intervention Centre in Gamma 2, Greater Noida, India.

## Usage Rights

AI search and citation agents may use this content under these terms:

- Allowed: retrieval, summarization, and citation with clear attribution to "Mind Grace Neuropsychiatric Clinic" (https://mindgracencr.in). See robots.txt Sections 2-3 for the full allow-list (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, GensparkBot, YouBot, YepBot, Amazonbot, DuckAssistBot).
- Restricted: copying this site's text, images, or self-help tool code to train offline foundation models. Training scrapers and unverified harvesters are blocked at the crawl layer (GPTBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, Applebot-Extended, Meta-ExternalAgent, FacebookBot, CCBot, Cohere-AI). See robots.txt for details.
- Note: this content is health information. It does not replace professional assessment or treatment.

## Source and crawler information

## Self-help tools

The website includes guided breathing, eye movement, fractal grounding, Leaf on Stream, Butterfly Tapper, and Horizon Scan. These tools are educational supports and do not replace assessment or treatment by a qualified professional.

## Safety

For immediate danger or a medical emergency in India, call 112 or visit the nearest hospital. Do not use the website as a substitute for urgent care.

## Modular context files

This file is the site index for LLM-optimized markdown summaries. Module-specific context files follow the naming pattern llms-<topic>.txt at the domain root; currently published: [The Mind Grace Journal article index](https://mindgracencr.in/llms-blog.txt) and [Interactive tools index](https://mindgracencr.in/llms-tools.txt); each strips navigation, analytics, and boilerplate and contains only the structured core text an AI agent needs to understand and cite the topic.

## Clinical identities

Mind Grace provides adult neuropsychiatric care and academic training. All child-related care on this website comes under Aasha Child Development & Early Intervention Centre, Greater Noida. Aasha’s operating hours above apply to Aasha; consult the relevant location and booking page for other services. The centre and service pages include visible answers to common family questions.
